description: A distortion that multiplies the signal up and folds back whatever passes 5V

params.text: Sets how much of what passes 5V is folded back: at 0 the signal is clipped flat at 5V, and higher settings fold it further back
Multiplies the signal by five times its setting, 0 to 10

inputs.text: A voltage here takes over from the GAIN knob, 0V to 10V
A voltage here takes over from the FOLD knob, 0V to 10V
